name: Pike Push-Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position, then walk your feet toward your hands, lifting hips high.
Your body forms an inverted V — this is the start position.
Bend the elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor.
Press back up. A bodyweight shoulder press progression toward handstand push-ups.
longevityNotes: Pressing keeps shoulders useful, but joint-friendly volume beats grinding maxes. Full range, controlled tempo, and balanced pulling keep the shoulders healthy for decades.
overview: Pike Push-Up is an intermediate pushing exercise for the front delts, performed with just your bodyweight. Pressing strength keeps daily pushing tasks — and your shoulders — working well for decades.
